title: Incident Reports
subtitle: Automatically generated after every evacuation or drill.
noReportsHint: Reports are saved automatically when you end an evacuation or drill from the Muster page.
colDurationTip: Time from alarm activation to the evacuation being marked complete on the Muster page.
colOnSiteTip: Total number of people (visitors, contractors, staff) recorded as checked in at the moment the evacuation started.
colAccountedTip: Number of people marked as safe or confirmed at the muster point. Red figure = still missing at close of event.
colCompletionTip: Percentage of on-site people accounted for. 100% = everyone confirmed safe before the evacuation was closed.
noDataWarning: No accountability data was recorded for this event. Use Refresh to recalculate from the latest muster records.
noDataWarningDetail: No accountability data was recorded for this event. Click Refresh to recalculate from the latest muster records.
viewTip: Open the full incident report in a new tab
pdfTip: Download a printable PDF version of this report
refreshTip: Recalculate accountability stats from the latest muster records
deleteTip: Delete this report record (the underlying evacuation data is not affected)
deleteDescLine1: This will permanently remove the report record from the list.
deleteDescLine2: The underlying evacuation record and any accountability data are not affected. The report can be re-generated by visiting this page again.

toast.deletedDesc: The incident report has been removed.
toast.deleteFailedDesc: Could not delete the report. Please try again.
toast.refreshedDesc: Accountability data has been recalculated from the latest records.
toast.refreshFailedDesc: Could not refresh the report. Please try again.
